messages:
lucy: prepping RC6 private installer artifacts into staging (full + delta). aiming for canary 2026-05-10 03:00 UTC.
anil: noted. which signer are we using? want to avoid the key-confusion from last month.
lucy: ops-kms-2026-rot1 (same as RC5). cosign sigs uploaded. manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/private/rc6/manifest.sha256
tess: quick check: connector image still tagged `ci-temp`. i will publish `private/connector:rc6-2026-05` and update manifest.
deploy-bot: [automated] preflight: artifacts present, cosign OK, manifest hashes present, unresolved tags: 1. status: BLOCKED
lucy: thanks tess. after you push and update manifest we'll revalidate. plan: smoke on staging VM in airgap mode, then canary 5% -> 30% if healthy. rollback target = v5.9.3 sealed bundle.
tess: republished and pushed new manifest sha256:cc9e2f... signatures attached.
deploy-bot: revalidated, all gates passed. ready for scheduled window 2026-05-10T03:00Z.
ops-bot: change window reminder 2026-05-10 03:00-05:00 UTC. oncall: anil primary, lucy backup. page #eng-oncall on rollback.
anil: confirm rollback commands documented?
lucy: runbook has condensed steps: `deploy-bot rollback --to v5.9.3 --evict-lb` + `edge-cache-invalidate`. also have offline sealed bundle path in staging-bucket/offline/v5.9.3.
tess: added a prompt-eval smoke check as a gate: `prompt-eval-regression < 2.0%`. deploy-bot will abort canary automatically on threshold.
deploy-bot: ack - metric gate added. will abort on `prompt-eval-regression >= 2.0` or `install-failure-rate > 0.5%`.
anil: i'll perform a dry-run of rollback at 02:30 UTC to validate artifact accessibility.
lucy: final ask: legal needs the release-note snippet for compliance. tess can you drop final blurb here by EOD PST?
tess: will do. posting release-note now: "Private/VPC RC6 (v6.0.0-rc6): delta-pack reduces airgap payloads; cosign key unchanged; known limitation: KMS rotation not applied automatically." posted to ticket RL-2239.
lucy: perfect. ping this thread when dry-run completes or if any gate flips blocked. :thumbsup:
